title: Patch: a cast from the deck is no play, and an evolved card comes back from the graveyard as printed
notes: Issue #3920: engine and card fixes for the daily super run. A card cast from its deck (S+ #89 Animosity) is a cast and no play, as a cast on draw is: nothing that counts or answers plays takes it, so Core #33 Unstable Clone Machine no longer copies it into an endless deck-cast loop (R3920001; handicapped seed 4517). A card that evolved in a graveyard or an exile pile and goes back to a hand or a library comes back as its printed card (R3920000; handicapped seed 2788). Stinkyscape+ #4 Profe Yates and #121 Toxopid print a cut short form instead of a clamp that ran off a 270 px face. No catalog change: the plays are the families classify finds playing differently in its forced and unforced games.

player.title: Casts from the deck and evolved cards behave
fixes: A card cast from your deck, such as Animosity, is no longer counted as a card you played, so Unstable Clone Machine no longer shuffles copies of it into your deck for it to cast again and again.
A card that evolved in your graveyard or exile and goes back to your hand or deck, such as Stinky Cheese returned by Reminisce, now comes back as its printed card.
Profe Yates and Toxopid show the start of their text on the card, ending in "…", rather than text cut off past the card's edge; the full text is in the preview.
